skill.name: DataStream Transformation Application
skill.description: Apply transformation functions (map, filter, flatMap, etc.) to a DataStream to create derived streams. Chains transformations to build processing logic by calling methods on DataStream objects.
skill.skill_body:
To transform a DataStream, call transformation methods on the DataStream object with a transformation function. For example, use map to convert each element: `val mapped = input.map { x => x.toInt }`. This creates a new DataStream by applying the function to every element in the original stream. Chain multiple transformations to build complex processing logic.

## Objective

Transform and derive new DataStreams from input data using element-wise or aggregation functions
## Applicable Signals

- Input DataStream[T] exists
- Transformation logic is defined (map, filter, flatMap, etc.)
- Downstream sink or further transformation is planned

## Contraindications

- No transformation needed; data already in final form
- Transformation function is undefined or invalid
- DataStream is null or uninitialized

## Workflow Steps

- Obtain or reference an existing DataStream[T]
- Define the transformation function (map, filter, flatMap, etc.)
- Call the transformation method on the DataStream with the function
- Capture the resulting DataStream[U]
- Chain additional transformations or proceed to sink

## Constraints

- Transformation function must be compatible with input element type
- Output type U must be serializable
- Chained transformations must maintain type compatibility

## Cautions

- Each transformation creates a new DataStream; original stream is not modified
- Complex nested transformations may impact performance; consider optimization
- Type mismatches in chained transformations will cause runtime errors

## Output Contract

- Returns a new DataStream[U] with transformation logic applied, ready for further chaining, sinking, or execution
